description: Identify and redistribute unequal caregiving workloads.
notes: Coded against the Kit contract with a guarded inline fallback shim (window.Kit || ...); the real shared/kit.js landed mid-build and takes precedence — all 10 verified against the real kit: zero console/page errors, core interactions clicked, 1280x800 shot captured.

notes.note: Quantifying sibling caregiving hours assumes the resentful family will co-adopt a fairness app together — which is precisely when they won't. The product's core interaction requires the cooperation its problem destroys. As a conversation-starter for one exhausted sibling it's useful; as a platform it's a fantasy.
